ruleDefinitions.name: Clearing Windows Console History
ruleDefinitions.description: Identifies when a user attempts to clear console history. An adversary may clear the command history of a compromised account to conceal the actions undertaken during an intrusion. Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Clear\\-History.*") OR (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Remove\\-Item.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*rm.*")) AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*ConsoleHost\\_history\\\.txt.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\(Get\\-PSReadlineOption\\)\\\.HistorySavePath.*"))
